verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a first-party MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API. That gives an AI-native user a sanctioned path to operate Billing through natural language from an agent client, but the natural-language interpretation comes from the external agent, not from Stripe Billing itself. The CLI and llms.txt are not natural-language operation and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a native natural-language assistant in the Dashboard or product, documentation of which Billing operations (subscriptions, invoices, prorations) can be driven conversationally, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
